items.title: Taupō Lake Cruise & Rock Carvings
items.summary: Sail across Lake Taupō to marvel at Māori rock carvings nestled along secluded volcanic coves.
items.description: Experience the spiritual and scenic serenity of Lake Taupō. Discover ancient Māori rock carvings guided by local kaitiaki who share genealogical legends (whakapapa) of Ngāti Tūwharetoa.

guide.name: Hemi Walker
guide.bio: Certified Māori cultural storyteller and lake navigator.

items.title: Milford Sound Eco-Wilderness Cruise
items.summary: Glacial fjords, thundering waterfalls, and playful fur seals in the heart of Piopiotahi.
items.description: Navigate towering sheer cliffs and cascade waterfalls beneath Mitre Peak in Fiordland National Park.
